title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
description: A drifter, a bandit and a bounty hunter reach a standoff over buried gold.

title: A Fistful of Dynamite
description: A thief and a dynamite-tossing Irish revolutionary inadvertently become embroiled in the Mexican Revolution.

title: The Mercenary
description: A Mexican patriot (Tony Musante) pampers a mercenary (Franco Nero) who shows him how to make a revolution.

title: The Hills Run Red
description: An ex-con sets out to kill his former partner, a soldier who escaped capture and made off with their stolen loot.

title: Billy Two Hats
description: A bearded Scot (Gregory Peck) robs a bank with a young Indian (Desi Arnaz Jr.), then leaves him with an old rancher's young wife.

title: The King and Four Queens
description: A drifter (Clark Gable) finds hidden gold in a town where a woman (Jo Van Fleet) lives with the wives of her bank-robber sons.

title: Cast a Long Shadow
description: A young man without surname inherits a big indebted ranch and has to prove his worthiness managing a cattle drive.

title: Day of the Outlaw
description: A rancher (Robert Ryan) and his rival fight back when an Army renegade (Burl Ives) and his gang take over a mountain town.

title: Man With the Gun
description: A hired gun (Robert Mitchum) saves a cow town from a land-grabber and wins back his wife (Jan Sterling).

title: The Wonderful Country
description: A Mexican-raised gunman (Robert Mitchum) romances an Army major's (Gary Merrill) wife (Julie London) while trying to run guns on the Texas border.

title: Young Billy Young
description: An old marshal (Robert Mitchum) finally faces his son's killer, joined by an outlaw (Robert Walker) who becomes his deputy.

title: Valdez Is Coming
description: A Mexican-American lawman (Burt Lancaster) gets even with a Southwestern rancher (Jon Cypher) for leaving him to die in the desert.

title: Cattle Annie and Little Britches
description: Two teenage girls rally what's left of the Doolin-Dalton outlaw gang after Doolin is caught.

title: Lawman
description: A marshal (Burt Lancaster) seeks justice in another marshal's (Robert Ryan) town, run by a corrupt rancher (Lee J. Cobb).

title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
description: Buffalo Bill Cody (Paul Newman) tries to be the Wild West legend his promoter (Burt Lancaster) creates for show business.

title: Ned Kelly
description: An Irish settler (Mick Jagger) and his brothers turn outlaw after their mother's arrest in frontier Australia.

title: The Missouri Breaks
description: An eccentric gunfighter (Marlon Brando) for hire must protect a cattle baron's herd from a rustler (Jack Nicholson) and his gang.

title: Cannon for Cordoba
description: Gen. Pershing sends an Army captain (George Peppard) to stop a Mexican bandit (Giovanna Ralli) and his army on the Texas border.

title: Gun the Man Down
description: An outlaw is left by his cohorts and girlfriend to be captured after he is wounded during a heist. When he is released from prison, he tracks his old crew to a run-down town and plays a game of cat and mouse with them.

title: Five Guns West
description: Five criminals are recruited by the Confederacy for a dangerous mission in exchange for a pardon. The men must travel to Kansas to intercept a stagecoach that is carrying a Confederate traitor and spy.

title: The Gunfight at Dodge City
description: Dodge City sheriff Bat Masterson tries to defeat villains and win a woman's heart.

title: Robbers' Roost
description: Trouble brews on the horizon when a disabled rancher hires two rival outlaw gangs to stand guard over his cattle.

title: Gunslinger
description: A Texas marshal's widow (Beverly Garland) wears his badge to stop a saloon keeper (Allison Hayes) and her hired gun (John Ireland).

title: Southwest Passage
description: A crook (John Ireland) and his girlfriend (Joanne Dru) join a trailblazer (Rod Cameron) taking camels to California.

title: The Honkers
description: An aging rodeo rider (James Coburn) thinks more of himself than he does of his wife (Lois Nettleton), son and best friend (Slim Pickens).

title: Rancho Deluxe
description: Disillusioned by the pressures of a responsible life, two men become aimless drifters and turn to cattle rustling.

title: Three Amigos!
description: Three silent-film cowboys (Chevy Chase, Steve Martin, Martin Short) come to Mexico to perform but instead are expected to save a town.

title: Support Your Local Sheriff!
description: A stranger (James Garner) tames an Old West boomtown and woos the mayor's daughter (Joan Hackett) on his way to Australia.

title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
description: A con man (James Garner) and his partner (Jack Elam) profit from mistaken identity in the mining town of Purgatory.

title: From Noon Till Three
description: A frontier widow (Jill Ireland) makes a pulp-novel legend out of her three-hour affair with a third-rate outlaw (Charles Bronson).

title: Breakheart Pass
description: An undercover agent (Charles Bronson) rides an Old West train with troops, killers and a mystery on board.

title: Invitation to a Gunfighter
description: A town boss hires a gunslinger (Yul Brynner) to kill an outcast (George Segal), then hires the outcast to kill the gunslinger.

title: Terror in a Texas Town
description: George Hansen returns to his Texas hometown after 20 years at sea, and learns that his father was murdered two days prior. George discovers that an oil speculator had his father killed for refusing to sell his land at an unfair price.

title: Man From Del Rio
description: A lawless frontier town, plagued by bandits, hires a notorious Mexican gunfighter to serve as its new sheriff.

title: Fort Defiance
description: A man (Ben Johnson) tracking a Civil War deserter (Dane Clark) helps him and his blind brother (Peter Graves) during an Indian attack.

title: Fort Bowie
description: A cavalry captain's (Ben Johnson) colonel (Kent Taylor) sends him on a suicide mission in Apache country.

title: The Glory Guys
description: A cavalry officer (Tom Tryon) and a frontier scout (Harve Presnell) vie for a woman (Senta Berger) and try to survive a general's orders.

title: Comes a Horseman
description: A rancher (James Caan) back from World War II helps a woman (Jane Fonda) fight a cattle baron (Jason Robards) who wants their Colorado land.

title: Quigley Down Under
description: An Old West sharpshooter goes to Australia, where his new boss expects him to kill Aboriginal Australians.

title: Wild Bill
description: The legendary gunfighter (Jeff Bridges) resumes romance with Calamity Jane (Ellen Barkin), faces an upstart and copes with his past in late-1800s Dakota Territory.

title: The Claim
description: Twenty years after a town's founder (Peter Mullan) trades his wife and daughter for a gold claim, the two arrive in his town.

title: Posse
description: Spanish-American War deserters (Mario Van Peebles, Stephen Baldwin, Charles Lane) wind up defending a black township from a sheriff and his henchmen.

title: Duel at Diablo
description: A scout (James Garner), an ex-sergeant (Sidney Poitier) and a cavalry lieutenant take ammo and recruits through Indian country.

title: Hour of the Gun
description: Wyatt Earp (James Garner) deputizes Doc Holliday (Jason Robards) and forms a posse to hunt Ike Clanton (Robert Ryan) and his gang.

title: Doc
description: Doc Holliday (Stacy Keach), Kate Elder (Faye Dunaway) and Wyatt Earp (Harris Yulin) hang out in Tombstone before the shootout at the OK corral.

title: The Long Riders
description: The Jesse James-Cole Younger gang leaves a trail of emptied banks, plundered stagecoaches and dead bodies in its wake.
